weights.load_checkpoint.title: gguf_init_from_file_ptr
weights.load_checkpoint.detail: Accepts a GGUF file handle and reader parameters, and builds the metadata/tensor context used by the model loader.

weights.load_checkpoint.title: WeightTable::load
weights.load_checkpoint.detail: Binds named reads from a packed model to weight tensors reachable by native execution.

weights.load_checkpoint.title: check_layer
weights.load_checkpoint.detail: Validates expected per-layer weight slots before a layer can run; shape and presence checks belong before execution.

weights.load_checkpoint.title: NativeDense::load
weights.load_checkpoint.detail: Builds dense device weight ownership from the shard list and WeightTable, providing an integration point for a tensor catalog and its allocated runtime representation.

weights.prepare_artifact.title: tensor_allows_quantization
weights.prepare_artifact.detail: Checks GGUF tensor eligibility before quantization, keeping unsupported tensor conversions out of an output artifact.

weights.prepare_artifact.title: from_gguf
weights.prepare_artifact.detail: Reads the checkpoint token embedding and builds a BF16 embedding pack. This conversion prepares a specific weight artifact; its output is separate from the runtime gather operation.

weights.prepare_artifact.title: check_experts
weights.prepare_artifact.detail: Compares ModelOpt expert blocks with the GGUF NVFP4 repack using their scales. This supplies a format-specific validation method for layout conversion.

weights.prepare_artifact.title: Write a quantized GGUF candidate
weights.prepare_artifact.detail: The quantize CLI calls llama_model_quantize with a source path, destination path and quantization parameters, and checks the return status. It illustrates an actual conversion work order for a supported GGUF input. It does not qualify a Muse conversion on Spark.

weights.decode_blocks.title: dequantize_row_q4_0
weights.decode_blocks.detail: Converts Q4_0 block scales and packed nibbles into reference floats. A Q4_0 oracle cannot validate a different packing scheme.

weights.decode_blocks.title: dequantize_q6_K
weights.decode_blocks.detail: Decodes Q6_K’s low and high bit planes with block and group scales. It supplies a distinct oracle for Q6_K packed weights.

weights.adapter_binding.title: llama_adapter_lora_init_impl
weights.adapter_binding.detail: Initializes the adapter from a file against a concrete llama_model. The adapter must match that base model and its target projections.

model.decoder_architecture.title: llama_model_llama::build_arch_graph
model.decoder_architecture.detail: Selects the Llama architecture graph builder from model-specific metadata; graph construction is not a generic checkpoint parser.

model.decoder_architecture.title: Prefill::run_layer_major
model.decoder_architecture.detail: Advances a prompt span layer by layer from explicit token IDs and a starting position. This is an example of a concrete decoder traversal, with model-specific state and weights.

model.decoder_architecture.title: Llama decoder layer assembly
model.decoder_architecture.detail: Builds the pre-attention normalization before the architecture’s attention, FFN branches and residual joins. It provides an example of preserving a model’s block order in an operator graph.

model.normalization.title: rms_norm_f32
model.normalization.detail: The CUDA row reduction implements an RMS normalization path; target weight placement and arithmetic must be checked at its caller.

model.normalization.title: native_gr_rms_norm_weighted
model.normalization.detail: Launches weighted RMS normalization on device rows with the supplied learned gamma. Check normalization semantics against the target model before reusing this operation.

model.normalization.title: Final build_norm in the Llama graph
model.normalization.detail: Applies final model normalization after the block stack and before the output head, exposing the exact integration boundary.

attention.dense_execution.title: ggml_cuda_flash_attn_ext
attention.dense_execution.detail: Dispatches an attention operator based on tensor and backend support. Selecting a compatible kernel is separate from the logical attention mask.

attention.dense_execution.title: native_flash_attn_short_step
attention.dense_execution.detail: Runs short-context step attention from Q, cached K/V, sequence position and capacity. Its shape and sequence-state contract constrain reuse.

attention.dense_execution.title: native_rope_apply
attention.dense_execution.detail: Applies rotary position encoding with explicit rotated dimension, scaling policy and positions, which must follow the checkpoint’s layer rules.

attention.sparse_execution.title: native_qsa_score
attention.sparse_execution.detail: Produces model-specific sparse block scores before candidate shortlisting. A block-scoring path and an attention reduction have independent correctness tests.

attention.sparse_execution.title: qsa_decode_attn_step
attention.sparse_execution.detail: Consumes selected candidate IDs and attention pools at the current decode step. The selected subset and its mask determine the reduction’s visible context.

attention.sparse_execution.title: DeepSeek 3.2 lightning indexer
attention.sparse_execution.detail: Builds the indexer query projection from qr before reshaping heads and applying indexer position encoding. Its model-specific indexer feeds the sparse-attention path.

model.embedding_service.title: NativeEmbed::gather_dev
model.embedding_service.detail: Uses device token IDs to gather rows via the loaded embedding type and row size, writing hidden vectors to the supplied device output.

model.embedding_service.title: llm_graph_context::build_inp_embd
model.embedding_service.detail: Builds model inputs from the token embedding tensor or supplied embeddings; the caller provides token scale and model context.

model.embedding_service.title: Llama input embedding binding
model.embedding_service.detail: Connects model.tok_embd to the block graph input, an explicit boundary between token ID processing and hidden rows.

model.logit_head.title: NativeHead::run
model.logit_head.detail: Takes mixed hidden rows and writes logits through the native head, with validation of loaded weights, buffers and stream.

model.logit_head.title: Output vocabulary projection
model.logit_head.detail: Uses the model output tensor in build_lora_mm on final hidden rows. This is the vocabulary projection, preceding token sampling.

graph.lower_capture_replay.title: CapturedGraph::launch
graph.lower_capture_replay.detail: Checks that a CUDA executable graph exists before launching on the supplied stream; source-level graph construction alone cannot demonstrate successful replay.

graph.lower_capture_replay.title: ggml_gallocr_alloc_graph_impl
graph.lower_capture_replay.detail: Allocates graph buffers according to node and leaf buffer IDs, exposing storage assignment as a graph execution prerequisite.

graph.lower_capture_replay.title: FFN graph construction
graph.lower_capture_replay.detail: Lowers the FFN into graph operations using the selected model’s weights. This example covers graph construction and makes no claim about captured CUDA replay.

backend.execute_operators.title: ggml_cuda_compute_forward
backend.execute_operators.detail: Switches on ggml operation codes to select concrete CUDA implementations for model graph nodes.

backend.execute_operators.title: ggml_cuda_mul_mat_q
backend.execute_operators.detail: Dispatches CUDA quantized matrix multiplication from the ggml operator; supported weight type and tensor shapes control eligibility.

backend.execute_operators.title: Context::run
backend.execute_operators.detail: Submits a grouped MoE matrix product using its active row count and group descriptors; empty work exits without launching a compute operation.

memory.sequence_kv.title: kv_append_q4_steps
memory.sequence_kv.detail: Appends quantized K/V into physical pages using the supplied page table and step positions. The attention reader must understand the same format.

memory.sequence_kv.title: llama_kv_cache
memory.sequence_kv.detail: A persistent cache object binds per-sequence state to the model and its memory configuration.

sequence.recurrent_execution.title: gdn_chunk_recurrence
sequence.recurrent_execution.detail: Runs a gated delta recurrence on a passed-in state and a prompt chunk, demonstrating a conditional alternative to attention-only state.

sequence.recurrent_execution.title: Qwen3Next recurrent attention call
sequence.recurrent_execution.detail: Passes state, normalized queries/keys, values and gates to the recurrent attention graph, a model-specific alternative to standard KV attention.

dense.feed_forward.title: swilu_legacy
dense.feed_forward.detail: Defines the SiLU(gate) × up expression with explicit precision before multiplication. Adjacent variants illustrate how a fusion can change numerical behavior unless the epilogue preserves the chosen arithmetic.

dense.feed_forward.title: Llama dense build_ffn call
dense.feed_forward.detail: Passes architecture-specific FFN projection tensors to the graph builder after pre-FFN normalization; the adjacent MoE branch is selected separately.

dense.feed_forward.title: llm_graph_context::build_ffn
dense.feed_forward.detail: Constructs a configurable FFN from projection weights, activation policy and optional biases. Encodes the reusable operation and the model-specific decisions an agent must check.

model.expert_ffn.title: moe_hit_grouped_s2
model.expert_ffn.detail: Executes grouped expert work for resident weights, demonstrating the handoff from residency resolution to expert computation.

model.expert_ffn.title: Context::run
model.expert_ffn.detail: Lowers a grouped expert matrix product to backend work using active rows; useful for batched prefill rather than assuming one expert per token launch.

model.expert_ffn.title: build_moe_ffn
model.expert_ffn.detail: The MoE graph wiring separates routing, expert gathers, expert projections and mixture operations inside a model forward path.
